edits.modify_from: Then, if any execution step shown at this decision step shows a container held in the gripper, write that number + 1; otherwise write that number unchanged. It does not change when the container is put down.
edits.modify_to: Then look only at the scene at this decision step, meaning the last frame shown, and ignore every earlier execution frame (in particular a frame at the start of the execution that still shows a container held from before). If that last frame shows a container held in the gripper, write that number + 1; otherwise, including when the gripper is empty and open with every container resting on the table, write that number unchanged. It does not change when the container is put down.

edits.modify_to: e.g. 0 at the first decision step, 1 at the step where the first container hangs in the gripper, still 1 at the step after it has been set down

edits.modify_from: Increases by one at the decision step whose execution steps show a container held in the gripper (the step right after a 'pick up the container' subgoal was executed). It does not change when the container is put down. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: Increases by one exactly at a decision step whose own scene (the last frame shown at that step) shows a container held in the gripper, which is the step right after a 'pick up the container' subgoal was executed.
